lead.headline: Golden kicks off tonight — and he is still on your bench
lead.deck: 12 hours to make the only projection change on either roster. JuiceJam started Walker; ESPN has you at 46%.
lead.body: Bad news first. Tuten's ankle is a high sprain he has carried since Week 8, and Coen will only say 'We'll see'. Jacobs is questionable for tonight, but LaFleur is 'not anticipating' it. Boswell now kicks for Mason Rudolph's offence after Pittsburgh benched Rodgers. JuiceJam moved Kenneth Walker III (21.4) into FLEX overnight, and ESPN has it 126.2 to 134.9. The one move that helps is still not made. Golden (16.7) sits behind Gordon (14.0), and he kicks off at the Rams at 19:00 CDMX. Swap them before then and Gordon becomes Tuten's Sunday fallback. Claims are done: KEI returns took Antonio Williams, and nothing left on the wire is worth season-long priority.

players.caption: Still benched — start him before 19:00 tonight.

doFirst.headline: Golden before 19:00; Tuten on Sunday
